wargear.name: Bile-stained banner
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A banner so thick with dried filth that the wind cannot lift it, carried by men who no longer notice the stink. Every model in the unit gains Feel No Pain (6+).

wargear.name: Choking cloud canisters
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Canisters of sour vapour cracked open as the squad closes. Every model in the unit gains Fear (1).

wargear.name: Bloated sarcophagus
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. The occupant has been dead for years and the machine has kept him going on rot. The model gains Feel No Pain (6+).

option.text: The Sergeant may take a plague weapon
Up to four Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
Any Deathshroud may exchange their power scythe for
The unit may carry a Bile-stained banner
The unit may carry Choking cloud canisters

modifiers.text: Stoic lords of the Legion: +1 LD, -1 I.

rules.name: Inexorable
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Unhurried Death). A unit with this rule may re-roll failed Morale Checks and failed Checks to avoid gaining Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Walking Dead
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Walking Dead March). A unit with this rule gains Move Through Cover. In any turn in which it did not move it also gains Feel No Pain (5+).

rules.name: Miasma of Contagion
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Doctrine of Contagion). Enemy units that charge a unit with this rule, or are charged by it, subtract 1 from their Weapon Skill for the first round of that combat.

rules.name: Sworn Guard
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Reaper's Honour Guard). A unit with this rule gains Feel No Pain (5+) while it is within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.

rites.name: Unhurried Death
rites.flavor: The Legion has never run, and it has never needed to.
benefits: Every Death Guard Infantry unit gains Feel No Pain (6+) and Inexorable: re-roll failed Morale Checks and Checks to avoid Tactical Statuses.
limitations: Every Death Guard Infantry unit loses 1 Move.
No Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: Unhurried Death: Feel No Pain (6+), Inexorable, -1 M.

rites.name: The Walking Dead March
rites.flavor: No tracks. No wings. Only the long walk, and the guns that come with it.
benefits: Grave Warden Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Walking Dead: Move Through Cover, and Feel No Pain (5+) in any turn they did not move.
limitations: At least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad is required.
No Transport or Heavy Transport units.
No unit may start the battle in Reserve: the whole army deploys on the table.

modifiers.text: The Walking Dead March: Line (1), Walking Dead.

require.note: Bring at least one Grave Warden Terminator Squad.

rites.name: Doctrine of Contagion
rites.flavor: A battle is won when the other side is too sick to hold the line.
benefits: Mortus Poisoner Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Fear (1).
They gain Miasma of Contagion: enemies that charge them, or that they charge, subtract 1 from Weapon Skill in the first round.
limitations: At least two Mortus Poisoner Squads are required.
No Apothecaries and no Primus Medicae.

modifiers.text: Doctrine of Contagion: Fear (1), Miasma of Contagion.

require.note: Bring at least two Mortus Poisoner Squads.

rites.name: The Reaper's Honour Guard
rites.flavor: Where the Primarch walks, the Deathshroud walk a pace behind, and nothing else is permitted near.
benefits: Deathshroud Terminator Squads may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Sworn Guard: Feel No Pain (5+) while within 6" of Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
limitations: The army must be led by Mortarion or Calas Typhon.
At least two Deathshroud Squads are required.
No Recon units, and no Heavy Assault units other than Grave Warden squads.

modifiers.text: The Reaper's Honour Guard: Line (1), Sworn Guard.

require.note: Mortarion or Calas Typhon must lead the army.
Bring at least two Deathshroud Squads.
